newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stocks continue slide on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stocks continue slide on profit-taking.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial stocks continued sliding on Tuesday amid profit-taking which brokers said had largely hit second tier stocks.
The key 57-share industrial index dropped 18.13 points to close at 8,081.51.
"Profit-taking hit second tier stocks where weaknesses emerged," one broker said.

Among the losers, horticulture group Ariston lost 50 cents to 1,600, pharmaceutical firm Caps shed 30 cents to 400 while sugar producer Hippo d2 he suspended the eor of theuntry's sole Sunday paper, the Sunday Mail.
